File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Update ExportButton to load and save the selected export format in localStorage so it remembers the user's last chosen format across reports and sessions.

label: feature
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

ExportButton initializes format from defaultFormat (defaulting to "csv") via useState without persisting the user's choice to localStorage.
Update ExportButton to load and save the selected export format in localStorage so it remembers the user's last chosen format across reports and sessions.
